resources.string: Please note that you CAN\'T watch, stream or download shows and movies with this app.\n\nUse apps like Netflix to stream and watch content.
Language can always be changed later via Settings.

This app uses your own TMDB key, so no key is shipped inside it and your usage is not shared with anyone else.\n\nCreate a free account at themoviedb.org, then copy the API key (v3 auth) from Settings → API and paste it below. You can change it later in Settings.
